# Gospel of Judas — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Tchacos, pp. 33-58 | Coptic

---

## The Secret Account of the Revelation That Jesus Spoke with Judas Iscariot

---

**1** The secret account of the revelation that Jesus spoke in conversation with Judas Iscariot, during a period of eight days, three days before he observed the Passover.

**2** When Jesus appeared upon the earth, he performed signs and great wonders for the salvation of humanity. While some walked in the way of righteousness, others walked in their transgressions. The twelve disciples were called.

**3** He began to speak with them about the mysteries that lie beyond this world and what shall come to pass at the end. Often he did not reveal himself to his disciples, but was found among them as a child.

**4** One day he came to Judaea and found his disciples gathered together and seated in pious devotion. When he drew near to them, they were assembled together offering a prayer of thanksgiving over the bread. He laughed.

**5** The disciples said to him: "Master, why do you laugh at our prayer of thanksgiving? We have done what is right."

**6** He answered and said to them: "I am not laughing at you. You are not doing this of your own will, but because through this your god receives glory."

**7** They said: "Master, you are [...] the Son of our God."

**8** Jesus said to them: "How do you know me? Truly I say to you, no generation of the people among you will know me."

**9** When the disciples heard this, they began to feel distressed and angry, and they started to blaspheme against him in their hearts.

**10** When Jesus observed their lack of understanding, he said to them: "Why has this agitation moved you to anger? Your god who dwells within you — together with his angels — has aroused your spirits against him."

**11** "Let anyone among you who is strong enough among human beings bring forth the perfect human being and stand before my face."

**12** They all said: "We have the strength." But none of their spirits dared to stand before him — except for Judas Iscariot. He was able to stand before him, yet he could not look him in the eye, but averted his face.

**13** Judas said to him: "I know who you are and from what place you have come. You have come from the immortal aeon of Barbelo, and I am not worthy to utter the name of the one who has sent you."

**14** Knowing that Judas was reflecting on something exalted, Jesus said to him: "Come away from the others, and I shall tell you the mysteries of the Kingdom. Not that you shall go there, but you will grieve greatly."

**15** When he had said this, Judas separated from the others, and Jesus led him away.

**16** He said to him: "Lift your eyes upward and look at the cloud and the light within it, and the stars that surround it. The star that leads the way — that is your star."

**17** Judas lifted his eyes upward and saw the luminous cloud, and he entered into it. Those who stood on the ground heard a voice from the cloud, saying: [...]

**18** Jesus came. He found the disciples gathered together and seated, and engaged in their acts of piety.

**19** They said: "Master, we saw you in a dream last night. We saw a great house, and in it a great altar. And there were twelve men — they are priests, we would say — and a name. And a great crowd of people was waiting around that altar."

**20** "And we said: 'Master, allow our priests to offer their offerings.' He said: 'What are you [...] doing?'"

**21** The disciples said: "Some fast for two weeks; some sacrifice their own children; others their wives, in praise and humility with one another; some sleep with men; some engage in killing; some commit a multitude of sins and lawless deeds. And the men who stand before that altar invoke your name."

**22** "And in all the works of their lack, those sacrifices are presented."

**23** When Jesus heard this, he laughed and said to them: "Why are you stirred up? Truly I say to you, all the priests who stand before that altar invoke my name. Again I say to you, my name has been written upon [...] of the generations of the stars through the human generations. And they have planted trees without fruit in my name, in a shameful manner."

**24** Jesus said to them: "Those you have seen receiving offerings at the altar — that is who you are. That is the god you serve, and you are those twelve men you have seen. The cattle brought for sacrifice are the many people you lead astray before that altar."

**25** "The one who will stand there [...] will make use of my name in this manner, and the generations of the pious will remain steadfast with him. After him another man will stand there from among the fornicators, and another from those who slay children, and another from those who sleep with men, and those who abstain, and the rest of the people of pollution and lawlessness and error, and those who say: 'We are like the angels.' They are the stars that bring everything to its end. For it has been said to the human generations, 'Look, God has received your sacrifice from the hands of a priest,' that is, a minister of error."

**26** "But it is the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, who commands — on the last day they will be put to shame."

**27** Jesus said: "Stop sacrificing [...] which you have [...] over the altar, since they are over your stars and your angels and have already come to their conclusion there. So let them go [...] before you, and let them go through [...] generations. A baker cannot feed all creation under heaven."

**28** "And [...] to them [...] as well as the fountain of wisdom. [...] a generation [...] light. In imperishability [...] since [...] came [...]."

**29** The disciples said: "Master, you have listened to all of this [...] What is the advantage that we have received? What is the advantage our fathers received, since they departed this life without seeing the aeons?"

**30** Jesus said — laughing — "What are you thinking within yourselves? Why does [...] mourn within you? Your god who is within you [...] together with [...] your [...] soul. [...] Let the strong one among you bring out the perfect human and stand before my face."

**31** They all said: "We have the strength." And none of them was able to stand except Judas Iscariot. He was able to stand before him yet averted his face, turning it aside.

**32** Judas said: "I know who you are and from what place you have come. You have come from the immortal aeon of Barbelo, and I am not worthy to utter the name of the one who has sent you."

**33** Knowing that Judas was reflecting on something exalted and apart, Jesus said to him: "Come away from the others and I shall tell you the mysteries of the Kingdom. It is possible for you to reach it, but you will grieve greatly."

**34** "For someone else will replace you in order to complete the twelve disciples before their god."

**35** Judas said to him: "When will you tell me these things, and when will the great day of light dawn for the generation [...]?"

**36** But when Jesus had said these things, he departed from him. On the following morning, after this had taken place, Jesus revealed himself to his disciples again.

**37** They said to him: "Master, where did you go and what did you do when you left us?"

**38** Jesus said to them: "I went to another great and holy generation."

**39** His disciples said to him: "Lord, what is this great generation that is superior to us and holier than us, which does not yet exist within these aeons?"

**40** When Jesus heard this, he laughed and said to them: "Why are you thinking in your hearts about the strong and holy generation?"

**41** "Truly I say to you, no one born of this aeon will see that generation, and no host of angels of the stars will rule over that generation, and no person of mortal birth can associate with it — because that generation does not come from [...] which has become [...] the generation of the people among [...] the power [...] the other powers [...] by which you rule."

**42** When the disciples heard this, each one was troubled in spirit. They could say nothing.

**43** On another day Jesus came to them. They said to him: "Master, we have seen you in a vision, for we had great dreams last night."

**44** He said: "Why have you [...] and why have you gone into hiding?"

**45** They said: "We saw a great house and within it a great altar, and twelve men — those we call the priests. And a name and a great crowd of people waiting around that altar."

**46** Jesus said: "Truly I say to you, that multitude crowded around the altar and that name — they are your priests. [...] And he will stand at the altar and use my name in this manner, and the generations of the pious will remain loyal to him."

**47** "After him another man will stand there from among the fornicators, and another from those who slay children, and another from those who sleep with men, and those who abstain, and the rest of the people of pollution and lawlessness and error, and those who say: 'We are like the angels.' They are the stars that bring everything to its end. For it has been said to the human generations, 'See, God has received your sacrifice from the hands of a priest,' that is, a minister of error."

**48** "But the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, will be put to shame on the last day."

**49** Jesus said to them: "Stop your [...]. [...] Your god will not be saved [...] generations will [...] the rulers [...] But I say to you, [...] the angel who [...] the holy ones and the generation [...] the light."

**50** Now Jesus spoke all these things. He took Judas aside privately and said to him:

**51** "Come — and I shall teach you about those things that no person has seen. For there exists a great and boundless aeon, whose extent no generation of angels has seen, in which dwells the great invisible Spirit. No eye of an angel has seen it, no thought of the heart has encompassed it, and it was never called by any name."

**52** "And a luminous cloud appeared there. And it said, 'Let an angel come into being as my attendant.' And a great angel, the divine light, the Self-Generated One, emerged from the cloud. Because of him, four more angels came into being from another cloud, and they became the attendants of the angelic Self-Generated One."

**53** "And the Self-Generated One said, 'Let [...] come into being [...],' and it came into being [...]. And he created the first luminary to reign over him. He said, 'Let angels come into being and serve him,' and myriads without number came into being. He said, 'Let a luminous aeon come into being,' and it came into being."

**54** "He created the second luminary to reign over him, together with myriads without number of angels to render service. In this manner he created the rest of the aeons of light. He made them reign over them, and for them he created myriads without number of angels for their assistance."

**55** "And Adamas was in the first luminous cloud that no angel had seen among all those called 'God.' He [...] the image [...] and after the likeness of that angel. He made the incorruptible generation of Seth appear — the twelve aeons of the twelve luminaries. And the twenty-four luminaries in their generation — that is, seventy-two luminaries in each of the aeons — and their power [...]."

**56** "And Saklas said to his angels, 'Let us create a human being after the likeness and after the image.' And they fashioned Adam and his wife Eve, who in the cloud is called Zoe — Life. For all the generations seek him by this name, and each calls her by her own names. Now Saklas did not [...] give the command except [...] the generations [...] And the ruler said to Adam, 'You shall live long, along with your children.'"

**57** Judas said to Jesus: "[What] is the long duration of time during which the human being will live?"

**58** Jesus said: "Why do you marvel that the spans of time of Adam, together with his generation — which is the number fixed as the limit of the time of Saklas — were determined? After this, that generation will be lifted up, and your star will lead the way. Look at the things that you will do. Truly I say to you, your last days [...] weep [...] the ruler will be destroyed [...] and then the image of the great generation of Adam will be exalted, for prior to heaven and earth and the angels, that generation from the eternal realms exists. Look, you have been told everything. Lift your eyes and look at the cloud and the light within it, and the stars surrounding it. The star that leads the way — that is your star." Judas lifted his eyes and saw the luminous cloud, and he entered into it. Those who stood on the ground heard a voice coming from the cloud, saying: [...] great generation [...] image [...] And Judas no longer saw Jesus. Immediately there was a disturbance among the Jews. [...] Their high priest and they said: "He has gone into the guest room to pray." Some scribes were there watching carefully so as to arrest him during prayer, for they were afraid of the people, since he was regarded by all as a prophet. They approached Judas and said to him: "What are you doing here? You are a disciple of Jesus." He answered them as they wished. And Judas received some money and handed him over to them.

---

*Source: Codex Tchacos, pp. 33–58. Coptic. Published by National Geographic Society (2006). Kasser, Meyer, Wurst, eds. Damaged or missing text indicated by [...]. Key theological terms: aeon (eternal divine realm), archon (ruler/lesser power), Barbelo (the first divine emanation), Saklas ("the fool," the demiurge), Self-Generated One (Autogenes, a divine being).*
